item.title: It started with a trolley...., 27th October
item.description:
And now the problem is so much worse. And I'm afraid so very afraid it will only get worse and worse and worse. The trolley was there....that was like okaaaaay. The next morning the trolley had a friend. A largeish box containing a box for a lava lamp. Other rubbish from the 90s gathered around it later that day....the huge metal part from a garden swing joined.... who knows what could have joined by the time I look again tomorrow. Please save us from the 90s!!! I remember it the first time

item.title: Vehicles driving against one way traffic, 27th October
item.description:
Vehicles are far too regularly turning left onto St Lukes Rd from College Rd at the junction where 44 St Lukes Rd is against the one way traffic. This is becoming at least a weekly occurence with risk of frontal collision and extensive traffic caused by drivers unable to reverse. the signage is grossly inadequate on College road and can barely be seen, leading to this becoming more and more regular
